note: Village of Wolverine campground in the 33-acre village park and trailhead (Lumberman's Park) at 5564 Cedar Street, on the banks of the Sturgeon River beside I-75 (exit 301) and the North Central State Trail; opened May 2020, expanded in 2025. Burn pits with wood provided when available, accessible fishing pier, nature trail along the river, kayak/canoe/tube launch. --Claude
summary: Village park/camping page (live, compromised) + its 2025 and 2026 Wayback snapshots: 15 sites with water and electric (confirmed; amperage not stated), showers/dump (confirmed) + potable water; fees new $35 (2025 electric & water; rustic $30 in the note; no residency split posted, no 2026 rates); reservable by phone (new). No season dates (the live page says 'The Campground is currently OPEN for the season'). Entry has no phone (flag). Note trimmed of field restatements.
